scope: Previously completed qualifications, short256 and formal6000, then source-identical functional commits. These are single hot full-task measurements, not repeated trials or full-model precision qualification.

full6000.phase_total_caveat: Rounded service phase totals are not additive GPU categories; READY waits are already included in decode.

short256.scope: Functional end-to-end qualification only; not comparable to full6000 throughput.

prefill_attention.scope: Native single-layer 8192 tokens x 128 heads, model scale 0.1352337788608801; same BF16 Q/K192 and V128. Compared against FP32 SDPA and old FA2 within tolerance, maximum absolute error 0.015625; no Q/K/V mutation.

prefill_normal_SM.outputs: Real R1 layer3, same weights/inputs/routing; all eight rank outputs byte-identical across scan.

prefill_silu_quant.cases: random, zero, tiny, exponent boundary and tails

MoE_combined_80SM_fused.scope: Single-layer maximum-rank median of event spans; includes CPU submission gaps, not pure communication or GEMM time.

decode_native_RoPE.outputs: Latent and finite Q/K bytes identical; NaN masks identical; matching input reset included in both timing paths.

static_cast.scope: Actual R1 FP32 router weights and BF16 rotary table conversions; same math with source version/layout, cache mapping and CUDA graph lifetime guards. Dynamic graph input, source mutation and output-byte checks passed.

method_limits: BCT uses complete response bytes; startup/full64warmup and postflight validation are excluded, service tokenization included, exactly original V2 scope.

Each original request-identity file is SHA-checked against its own receipt. Full6000 cross-run input comparison excludes run-local rid only after validating it, and checks every ordinal/source ID/token hash/length and prompt UTF8 hash from independently byte-pinned original requests. Raw output bytes are SHA-checked if exported, not independently retokenized.
Only receipt-bounded service-window log time/counters belong to measured task; full service logs include warmup and are used only for startup capacity/backend evidence.
Phase summary seconds are server-reported rounded phase totals, not additive GPU categories or cross-rank wall sums. H2D READY waits are included inside decode.
Graph capture/replay log evidence supports mechanism; periodic wrapper counters are not an exact count of all model forwards including warm/capture.
Old8064/9344 and new scheduler iter counters are loop attempts, never exact model-forward counts.
No new profiler result, GPU activity timeline, bandwidth or precision qualification is inferred from this offline performance audit.
The three full-task versions each have one valid run; no confidence interval.
No per-patch full6000 ablation; combined gains cannot be assigned to individual patches.
Workload derives from existing LongBench material; not claimed to be the paper authors original request file.
BG and SG are independently tuned with different concurrency and KV capacity; SG uses an experimental R1 FP8 MegaMoE bridge and newer dependencies.
Cross-framework dense/router/activation quantization and top-k weighting differences remain; whole-model accuracy alignment was not performed.
private_evidence_scope: Original receipts/logs/qualification outputs remain in the existing local campaign archive, not embedded in this source freeze. Relative keys name files within that archive; SHA pins identify evidence, not public URLs.
